class.name: dual_arm_hardware_interface/DualArmsHardwareInterface
class.description: Combined hardware interface for BOTH arms (plus head). Issues exactly ONE ControlApi::move_joint(Group::ALL, ...) per control cycle so the SDK emits a single UDP packet per cycle. Use this when both arms must move simultaneously at 100 Hz.

class.name: dual_arm_hardware_interface/LeftArmHardwareInterface
class.description: Left arm only. Sends one packet per cycle for the left arm; the right arm is held at its current position. Do NOT use together with RightArmHardwareInterface at 100 Hz — see DualArmsHardwareInterface.

class.name: dual_arm_hardware_interface/RightArmHardwareInterface
class.description: Right arm only. Same caveat as LeftArmHardwareInterface.

class.name: dual_arm_hardware_interface/HeadHardwareInterface
class.description: Head (pan/tilt) hardware interface. Drives dual_arm_v2_2_sdk::Group::HEAD via ControlApi::move_joint(). When DualArmsHardwareInterface is used, the head is already covered by that class — do not declare HeadHardwareInterface in the same URDF.

class.name: dual_arm_hardware_interface/ElevatorHardwareInterface
class.description: Elevator (vertical lift) hardware interface. Drives dual_arm_v2_2_sdk::Group::ELEVATOR via ControlApi::move_joint().

class.name: dual_arm_hardware_interface/LeftGripperHardwareInterface
class.description: Left gripper hardware interface. Drives "gripperL" via ControlApi::set_gripper_position(Group::LEFT_ARM, ...).

class.name: dual_arm_hardware_interface/RightGripperHardwareInterface
class.description: Right gripper hardware interface. Drives "gripperR" via ControlApi::set_gripper_position(Group::RIGHT_ARM, ...).
